title: Russia Strikes Kyiv Bridge in Daytime Drone Attack, Large Fireball Erupts
detail: Russia conducted fresh drone and missile strikes on Kyiv, directly hitting a bridge in a rare daytime attack that produced a large visible fireball. The strike caused significant damage and disruption to traffic infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital. Moscow simultaneously issued warnings of further retaliation following Ukrainian long-range drone strikes on Russian territory, including oil refineries and defense plants in recent days.

media.caption: Fireball erupts as Russian drone hits Kyiv bridge in daytime attack
